user.title: Connect FRITZ!Box
user.description: Credentials of a FRITZ!Box user with the telephony permission. TR-064 must be enabled under Home Network > Network > Network Settings > "Allow access for applications".

data.port: Port (optional, defaults depend on the TLS setting)

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to the FRITZ!Box again
reauth_confirm.description: The FRITZ!Box {host} rejected the stored credentials. Please enter new credentials.

reconfigure.title: Change the FRITZ!Box connection
reconfigure.description: Adjust host, port, encryption or credentials. It has to remain the same FRITZ!Box.

data.port: Port (optional, defaults depend on the TLS setting)

discovery_confirm.title: Set up the FRITZ!Box {name}
discovery_confirm.description: A FRITZ!Box was found at {host}. Enter the credentials of a FRITZ!Box user with the telephony permission.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the FRITZ!Box.
error.invalid_auth: Wrong username or password, or the user lacks the telephony permission.

abort.wrong_device: A different FRITZ!Box answers under these details than the one originally set up.
abort.no_host: The address of this FRITZ!Box could not be determined.
abort.no_telephony: This device (for example a repeater) has no telephone function.

data.enable_call_monitor: Enable the call monitor (real-time call state)
data.prefixes: Country prefixes for number matching (e.g. +49), comma separated; empty = country of Home Assistant
data.phoneblock_enabled: Enable PhoneBlock spam detection (free account on phoneblock.net required)
data.phoneblock_spam_threshold: Spam threshold (%, a number counts as spam from this spam probability)
data.reverse_lookup_enabled: Enable online reverse lookup via Tellows (sends unknown phone numbers in clear text to tellows.de, no account needed)

error.phoneblock_credentials_required: PhoneBlock is enabled, but the username and/or password are missing.

mark_message_read.name: Mark message as read
mark_message_read.description: Marks an answering machine message as read or unread.

message_index.name: Message index
message_index.description: Index of the message (see the 'messages' attribute of the answering machine sensor).

read.name: Read
read.description: On = mark as read, off = mark as unread.

delete_message.name: Delete message
delete_message.description: Permanently deletes an answering machine message on the FRITZ!Box.

message_index.name: Message index
message_index.description: Index of the message (see the 'messages' attribute of the answering machine sensor).

download_message.name: Download message
download_message.description: Deprecated: saves the recording as a file under config/www/fritzbox_tam/. These files can be fetched without logging in - the card plays recordings signed in, straight from the FRITZ!Box, instead. Only file names ending in .wav, .mp3 or .ogg are accepted.

message_index.name: Message index
message_index.description: Index of the message (see the 'messages' attribute of the answering machine sensor).

dial.name: Dial a number
dial.description: Starts a call with the FRITZ!Box dial help: the phone chosen there rings first, and the number is dialed once you pick up. The dial help must be enabled on the box.

hangup.name: Cancel dialing
hangup.description: Cancels a call that was started with the dial action and has not been answered yet.

lookup_number.name: Look up a number
lookup_number.description: Returns what is known about a phone number: phonebook contact, area, PhoneBlock spam rating and Tellows reverse lookup (when enabled).

not_answering_machine.message: This action only works with the sensors of an answering machine.

box_request_failed.message: The FRITZ!Box did not carry out the request: {error}

device_required.message: More than one FRITZ!Box is set up - please choose the device.

no_box.message: No FRITZ!Box is set up or loaded.
